title: Token Pass now includes $150 in tokens for $30/month
summary_en: Vercel Token Pass now includes $150 of tokens per month (up from $80) for the same $30 per team per month. The credit applies to featured open-weight models served through AI Gateway , including Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Credit resets each billing period with no rollover. When it runs out, requests using standard AI Gateway keys or OIDC tokens fall back to the team's AI Gateway balance, while requests using Token Pass-scoped keys stop with no overage charges. Token Pass is an Early Access add-on for Pro teams, with limited spots and a waitlist…
